verdict.rationale: Reflect documents one-click, in-app publishing of individual notes to a public, unguessable URL with clean, minimal-branding styling. That covers publishing selected notes without leaving the app. There is no evidence that published notes form a browsable, interlinked site or that wiki-links between published notes resolve. Missing for 10: a multi-note browsable site or digital-garden structure, working links between published notes, navigation or index pages, independent or hands-on corroboration.
